sample_values: Psidium guajava L. cv. Allahabad Safeda
Multilayer Laminate (PET 12 µm / EVOH 10 µm / PE 48 µm)
Facultative anaerobe; growth retarded by high CO2 (40-60%) combined with refrigeration.
Strict aerobe; primary spoilage organism in fresh produce/meat; strongly inhibited by CO2 > 20% and O2 < 1%.
Primary postharvest fungal pathogen in berries/grapes; inhibited by elevated CO2 (10-15%).
Mesophilic pathogen; growth arrested at T < 5.2°C.
Aflatoxin producer in stored grains/nuts; controlled by hermetic sealed storage maintaining low O2 (<2%) or aw < 0.70.
